selection: Three non-acetal acyclic ethers, n-propyl acetate, toluene, acetone, NO and CH4 are held out. Acetal compounds remain in training.
split: Eight test identities; all NO/CH4 line-list test references use HITEMP, including the CH4 4000-4700 cm-1 window.
broad_windows: Fixed400cm-1 tiles with boundaries600+400k; clamped to source/input support, minimumwidth30cm-1. Keep if positiveintegratedcoldanchorarea is at least2%of summedcoldarea acrosscandidatewindows. No hotvalues orerrors determinewindowselection.
short_windows: Published coordinatecoverage at most600cm-1 retained, intersected with contiguouscoverageofallinputs and predefined digitizedcoverage.
source_inputs: PNNL inputs or up to three distinct published source spectra at or below 350 K. Targets exceed warmest input and 323.15 K.
robustness_exclusion: Propane1000K Wakatsuki digitization retained as robustness-only due source-decompositionwarning; no primaryaggregate.

quality_flags: Source reports possible thermal decomposition at1000K; robustness only.
